\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{moreverb}
% A label that the document defines: text in the listing's typewriter
% font, a number in roman at another size, and a colon in the base font.
\makeatletter
\renewcommand\verbatim@font{\footnotesize\ttfamily}
\makeatother
\renewcommand\listinglabel[1]{%
  \llap{vf-label-{\scriptsize\rmfamily\the#1}{\normalsize\normalfont:}}\hskip\listingoffset\relax}
\begin{document}
\begin{listing}{1}
vf-pitch-first
vf-pitch-second
vf-pitch-third
\end{listing}
% (a label defined in the body)
\renewcommand\listinglabel[1]{\llap{vf-body-\the#1}\hskip\listingoffset\relax}
\begin{listing}{1}
vf-body-listing
\end{listing}
\end{document}
